Throwaway test certificates for `crates/cli/tests/stdlib_tls.rs`. `ca.pem` signed `server.pem` (valid for `localhost` and `127.0.0.1`); the CA private key was discarded after signing. `other-ca.pem` is an unrelated CA used to prove that untrusted issuers are rejected. None of these keys protects anything. `client-ca.pem` signed `client.pem`/`client.key` (extended key usage `clientAuth`) for the mutual-TLS tests; its private key was also discarded. `rogue-client.pem`/`rogue-client.key` were signed by a CA that is not distributed, to prove that a server rejects client certificates from an untrusted issuer.
